propositions: s3_doctor's _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the checked-out worktree HEAD rather than the published ref tip, making the heal result dependent on the tracker's current branch state
_require_tracker_on_ref refuses heals when the checked-out branch differs from the ref, preventing off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers from being healed
The refusal guard must be replaced with a mechanism that folds heads into refs/heads/<ref> using git merge-tree and commit-tree, eliminating the branch-state dependency
Publishing the folded result requires different strategies for on-branch (git reset --hard) and off-branch (git update-ref) scenarios to keep index and worktree consistent
Merge policy enforcement via merge=ours driver must be preserved when folding heads, requiring validation that git merge-tree honors the ours driver identically to git merge
The heal must succeed for side-branch and detached-HEAD trackers, leave off-branch worktrees unchanged, and refuse only when the tracked worktree is dirty on the ref itself
